Tess (Finance): billing-bot flagged an overnight GPU spend spike in project 'nightly-batches' — +300% vs baseline. link: https://redwood.app/billing/projects/nightly-batches/overview @Arjun @Marta
billing-bot: ALERT: project=nightly-batches period=2026-06-12T00:00..06:00 gpu_cost=21,400usd baseline=5,200usd top_groups=[nightly-pipeline,ad-hoc-backfills] export=/billing/export?ts=1881234567
Arjun (FinOps): can someone paste the top instance groups? want to attribute to product customers vs platform test runs before we decide credits
Marta (Scheduler): checking scheduler logs. quick find: cron 'backfill-all' had a misconfigured concurrency override and launched 18 workers instead of 3 at 00:05. it ran heavy training jobs for ~4h. PR that changed it: https://git.redwood/sched/merge/9045
Ken (SRE): are those workers labeled? we need label:team and label:customer for attribution. if unlabeled, they'll be unattributed in billing reports
Tess (Finance): attached export sample (anonymized):
```
project,instance_group,cost_usd,labels
nightly-batches,nightly-pipeline-18,12,400,customer=;team=platform;job=backfill-all
nightly-batches,ad-hoc-backfills-3,6,200,customer=data-team;team=data;job=manual-backfill
nightly-batches,dev-test-9,2,800,customer=trial-x;team=dev;job=test-harness
```
Arjun (FinOps): looks like majority is unlabeled (platform-run). propose: 1) charge platform budget for unlabeled 2) credit data-team for their portion 3) patch scheduler to cap concurrency and add lint to disallow concurrency>8 in prod projects
Marta (Scheduler): will revert the concurrency override and file a lint. deploying revert now: https://git.redwood/sched/merge/9050
Ken (SRE): running a backfill to add owner tags for the last 72h using job metadata. can recover ~70% of unlabeled resources. will post mapping in 90m
billing-bot: NOTE: budget_alert created project=nightly-batches threshold=85% recipients=[tess@redwood.com,arjun@redwood.com]
Tess (Finance): approve provisional charge to platform budget for unlabeled amount. Arjun, please prepare a short memo with numbers for the execs and a recommendation on chargeback vs absorb
Arjun (FinOps): will post attribution table in 2 hours. also propose adding an automated daily health check for scheduled job concurrency anomalies
Marta (Scheduler): adding runbook step to notify owners when scheduled jobs exceed expected concurrency. thanks all. :thumbsup:
